mode: direct L1 writes through memory_add (high-privilege mode on, no model-driven extraction), embeddings off (plugin default), default recall strategy hybrid = keyword retrieval only
how: memory_add.execute({content, created_at, updated_at}) per memory (registered by apply(ctx, config)); ranked = memory_search.execute({query, limit:10}) (L1Store.search, keyword/BM25 over a jieba + CJK bigram tokenised FTS index); deployed = the agent/pre-step hook chain: L1Store.search(query, 5, scoreThreshold 0.3) -> domain soft gate -> freshness weighting -> per-session de-duplication -> character budget (500 per memory, 2000 total) -> '<relevant-memories>' injection message
notes: Package: dsh-prime-memory 0.26.55 (npm tarball), dist/index.js imported unmodified. Dependencies as declared by the package (jieba, sqlite-vec, undici, schemastery) installed from npm during the image build; host packages @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm, dsh-tools, dsh-home-paths are stubbed (a message constructor, an identity defineTool, a path helper).

Write path: the product writes memories through a model-driven pipeline (raw turns, then L1 extraction and de-duplication by a model, then scene and persona distillation). None of that is measured. Every memory is written verbatim with memory_add, which the plugin offers for 'remember this' requests and gates behind a high-privilege setting (switched on here). type = the tool default (episodic), priority = default 80, created_at/updated_at = the memory's date at 12:00 UTC. L2/L3 distillation, the persona and scene navigation blocks (system-prompt side) are not part of the measured lists.

deployed = the memory injection message the pre-step hook adds before the user message; the adapter runs the plugin's registered pre-step handlers as a chain with a stand-in agent whose message has source kind user. Each question uses a fresh agent id (the plugin does not re-inject records already injected into the same session). The injected items carry no ids: an item is matched to a memory by its full text, and an item the plugin shortened (over 500 characters, or over the rest of the 2000-character budget; it ends with the plugin's fixed suffix) by its unique prefix. A shortened memory counts as delivered and is marked `shortened`; `chars` is the length of the item as injected. Items that match no memory count as noise.
ms times the whole pre-step chain for one question (all registered handlers, one of which is the memory injection).
Date.now() is set to the day after the last memory while questions run, so the plugin's 30-day freshness weighting sees real ages; during ingest the real clock runs and dates are passed explicitly.
ranked = memory_search tool, which applies no score threshold; it is the same search as the hook's, with the hook's threshold, domain gate, per-session suppression and budget applied afterwards.
Write failures: 0. Question failures: 0. Returned items that could not be mapped to a memory id: 0. Delivered items shortened by the plugin: 0. Attempts to call a model: 0.
